unwindFamily.evidenceBoundary: Exact declared exception-table framing and complete parent triples establish selected-primary range membership, including nested and noncontiguous chains. Version 1/2 code-slot contents, fixed-allocation consistency, handlers, managed control flow, live MethodInfo and execution remain separate proofs; adjacency and start-address-only joins are not used.

evidenceBoundary.exact: Complete declared exception-owned initializer bytes, syntactic graph and stack joins, selected range/loop/kind-three argument programs, and independently checked constructor/base context consumers.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Range start/count feed sixteen-byte definitions; each normal iteration advances the definition pointer sixteen and output pointer eight, decrements the same remaining count, and publishes the original output-array return. Kind three passes both descriptor operands with one saved context and stores the complete final helper return.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: With the authenticated class/module context, correct range selection, valid allocation/fill result, stable disjoint frame/definition/output storage and normal ABI-preserving helpers, metadata slot seven occupies output byte offset fifty-six in the class context field read by the constructor.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Full syntactic CFG reachability does not prove loop termination, helper effects, runtime slot values or metadata semantic identity of anonymous descriptor/callback storage.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Actual class/context initialization, method-descriptor substitution and cache selection, cold target equality to the registered RET0 pointer, positive camera list composition and gameplay execution.
